caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed against a plain, light-colored background. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body that tapers toward a short, narrow neck with a small, circular opening at the top. Attached to the neck is a curved handle that connects to the upper body of the jug. The surface of the jug is predominantly an olive green color with areas of brown, orange, and tan, particularly around the neck and handle. There are several small, circular orange spots distributed across the surface, along with some subtle dark specks and marks. The bottom edge of the jug has a reddish-brown tone. Shadows and highlights are used to give the jug a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "WILLIAM SPIECKER," is visible below the jug on the right side of the image.
title: Galena Big Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
